baseline.name: Baseline (E4 top-1)
baseline.description: 当前 project-side 选择规则：对单个 text query 取 OwlPredictor.decode 返回的所有 score>threshold patches 中最高分的一个 (top-1 by language score)，无 NMS，无 spatial consensus
baseline.box_selection: argmax_{i} score_i, among patches where score_i > threshold

method_a.name: Score-Weighted Box Fusion
method_a.description: 对 top-K 候选（按 language_score 降序，K=5 冻结）进行加权融合：weight = softmax(score / temperature)，fused_box = Σ w_i * box_i
method_a.rationale: temperature=0.1 是检测领域常用的 softmax temperature（DETR/Transformer 检测器惯例），低温使高分候选权重更集中，避免被低分噪声稀释
method_a.note: 不做动态 spatial clustering（会引入额外超参），直接对 top-K 全体融合

method_b.name: Best Spatial Consensus Candidate
method_b.description: 从 top-K 候选中选择 consensus score 最高的一个：consensus_i = score_i * mean_IoU(box_i, box_j for j in top-K)^gamma，gamma=2 惩罚孤立框
method_b.rationale: gamma=2 是平方惩罚，使孤立框（mean_iou接近0）的 consensus score 接近0；gamma=1 为线性，gamma=2 为二次惩罚，折中选择
method_b.note: mean_pairwise_iou_i = mean(IoU(box_i, box_j)) over all j != i in top-K；如果 top-K < 2，fallback 为 top-1

evaluation_protocol.dataset: evaluation_split.json (33 instances, stratified from E4 fixed 50 cases)
evaluation_protocol.nanosam_backend: FP16 50-epoch production encoder (SHA 99147caf, same as E1-E5)
evaluation_protocol.failure_category_analysis: of original 17 B_localization_propagation cases in eval split, count improved/recovered/unchanged/worsened

decision_gate.LOCALIZATION_REFINEMENT_HELPFUL: (box_iou stable improvement) AND (mask_iou synchronized improvement) AND (no obvious detection collapse)
decision_gate.LOCALIZATION_REFINEMENT_NO_CLEAR_GAIN: (box improvement small) OR (mask not synchronized) OR (many cases degraded)
decision_gate.note: 两种结论都是有效实验结果，不预设必须成功

prohibition.no_gt_at_inference: GT box 只能用于 evaluation，绝对不能参与 box 选择、权重计算、参数选择、threshold 动态调整（会造成 data leakage）
prohibition.no_param_tuning_on_eval: 不允许在 evaluation_split 上调整 temperature, gamma, top_k 等参数后再报告同一 eval 集合的最终结果；参数已在此文档冻结，基于通用检测惯例和 dev_split 观察（非调优）选择
prohibition.no_method_stacking: 如果方法A和方法B都无明显收益，不继续堆叠第3、4、5个 heuristic，直接得出 TRAINING_FREE_LOCALIZATION_REFINEMENT_INSUFFICIENT 结论
